rows.name: Sorry flowers
rows.descriptionMd: Pale roses, white tulips, freesias and a small box of pastel flowers — quiet rather than grand, which is usually the right register when you are apologising. A printed card is free and worth using here. Choose where it is going and the day you want, and we take care of the rest. Every order is made by hand and delivered in person by our florist in the recipient's city.
rows.seoTitle: Sorry flowers: apology flowers delivered across Europe
rows.seoDescription: Pale roses, white tulips, freesias and small pastel boxes: quiet rather than grand. A free printed card, and it arrives on the date you pick.
